[h2]The Bazaar[/h2]
[list]
[*] Loads of the game's building sets and plenty of other stuff are stuck behind a paywall. These used to be sold as DLC, but as you can see, they haven't released a DLC since 2021, and now they're exclusively available through the in-game store called the Bazaar. The newest one, the Splendors of Vendhya Bundle, costs 11,000 Crom Coins (roughly $90 to $100). I shelled out for it because it came out right after the UE5 port, and man, I have to say, these building pieces look stunning. [url= https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3805385064]See for yourself.[/url]
[/list]
[h2]The Annoying Parts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unlike in other survival building games, where everything you clear away when preparing for a build, including rocks, trees and plants, only respawns when you log off, in Conan even the branches respawn right where you collected them, which is very annoying when you're trying to take a screenshot of a build. You could spend half an hour preparing the ground for a build, only for it all to respawn while you're still working on it.
[*] I found placing chests rather annoying because there is no snapping feature, not to the floor and, more importantly, not to one another, meaning you can't easily stack four chests without them looking like someone was drunk when placing them.
[/list]
[h2]Compared to Enshrouded[/h2]
[list]
[*] This next one is gonna be subjective, but I can't help comparing this game to Enshrouded. Conan has triangular building pieces, while Enshrouded doesn't. But Enshrouded has a way better theme and a much more beautiful vibe to it than Conan. Also, I don't know how this game looked before the Enhanced version, but the world textures, like the grass and everything, are much more detailed in Enshrouded (both maxed out). Conan also lacks some quality-of-life features around chests, like the ability to quickly deposit items that match what's already in the chest. Overall, I love both games, but for different reasons.
[/list]
[h2]The Only Game to Beat Your Girlfriend's WickedWhims-Modded Sims 4[/h2]
[list]

The modding community is also quite diverse, and there are tons of BDSM mods, RP servers and communities floating around, which are pretty amazing if you're into that.
[/list]

Conan Exiles: Enhanced Edition
A Glimpse Into The Hyborean Age.

Conan Exiles: Enhanced embraces the mature, brutal identity of the Conan universe while expanding upon it with distinctive character customization. The enhanced customization options and inclusion of nudity are particularly notable features, and while they may limit the game's appeal to some audiences, that feels appropriate for a franchise built around violence, sexuality, and the darker elements of the Hyborian Age. The survival and combat systems are otherwise familiar territory, closely resembling games such as ARK: Survival Evolved, SCUM, and Rust. That familiarity isn't a flaw; the mechanics are intuitive, accessible, and easy to understand for anyone familiar with the survival genre.

Crafting, exploration, and building follow a similarly recognizable formula, with players gathering resources, discovering recipes, and progressing toward increasingly advanced equipment and structures. The building system provides enough flexibility to create everything from simple shelters to enormous fortresses and settlements. Where Conan Exiles truly distinguishes itself is its Thrall system. Capturing NPCs, equipping them, specializing them, and assigning them as workers or warriors allows players to essentially construct their own cities and armies. This gives NPC encounters meaningful consequences, transforming raids from simple resource-gathering exercises into opportunities to expand the civilization you're building.

The game's biggest weakness is its grind, particularly when combined with its multiplayer environment. Progression can become extremely resource-intensive, while servers can be plagued by hackers and massive clans that effectively control entire regions of the map. When important resources, locations, or progression opportunities are monopolized by established groups, the open-world survival experience can become frustrating for newer or independent players. The underlying systems are enjoyable, but the multiplayer environment can make progressing through them feel unnecessarily difficult.

Where Conan Exiles succeeds most is in its atmosphere and connection to the broader Conan and Hyborian Age mythos. Its architecture, enemies, lore, and environments generally feel authentic to the setting, although the world can sometimes feel geographically disconnected from the larger Hyborian Age, with dramatically different biomes compressed together in ways that feel artificial. The Isle of Siptah also feels somewhat reminiscent of the isolated, self-contained map philosophy established by ARK. Even so, Conan Exiles: Enhanced Edition remains a compelling survival sandbox—not because it radically reinvents the genre, but because it combines familiar survival mechanics with an exceptionally mature setting, flexible construction, and one of the genre's most distinctive systems in the form of its Thralls.

Conan Exiles Enhanced — A Masterclass in Survival and Conquest
Rating: 10/10
Recommended: Yes

If you are looking for a survival game that actually respects your time, feeds your inner architect, and offers an unmatched sense of brutal adventure, Conan Exiles Enhanced is an absolute must-play.

Having spent countless hours deep in the Exiled Lands, this game completely nails the core pillars of what makes the genre great:

Brutal, Satisfying Combat: The combat feels weighty, responsive, and genuinely dangerous. Every swing, dodge, and parry matters, making victories against terrifying beasts and rival exiles feel thoroughly earned.

Exploration & Environment: The world design is simply breathtaking. From sun-baked deserts and ruined cities to oppressive jungles and freezing mountain peaks, every biome tells a visual story of a harsh, ancient world waiting to be uncovered.

Base Building: The building system is easily one of the best in the industry. Whether you are throwing together a quick outpost or engineering an unassailable fortress that clings to a cliffside, the architectural freedom and structural detailing are top-tier.

The Thrall System: Capturing and breaking unique thralls to defend your base, craft gear, and fight shoulder-to-shoulder with you out in the wild adds a brilliant layer of progression and attachment to your followers.

The Ultimate Loot Chase: Scouring high-level dungeons, legendary bosses, and hidden vaults for rare gear and recipes keeps the adrenaline pumping and the progression loop addictive.

The Modding Ecosystem: This is where the game truly ascends. Thanks to an incredible modding community, you can completely tailor and expand your experience, adding quality-of-life tweaks, massive new content, and deep customization that turns a great game into an endless playground.

Stunning Visuals & Performance: Running this with DLSS 5 Neural rendering makes the world look jaw-droppingly sharp and immersive while keeping frame rates buttery smooth.

Conan Exiles Enhanced delivers an unforgettable survival journey that keeps you coming back for "just one more hour." Grab your weapon, build your empire, and conquer the wasteland.
